_predictions.note: All argued in §10.130 / the handover of 2026-11-22, none read; written before the run (§2.8).
_predictions.pumpjacks: First holder in the 1870s (m12b-first 1906), and the motor's Compound Engines rung staffed from then.
_predictions.combustion_and_electric_railway: First holders back near the canon's (1903, 1904), against m12b-first's 1918 and 1919.
_predictions.anchor_era4: The leader's share of tech era 4 production technologies at 1905 above m12b-first's 31% (the canon 56%).
_predictions.financial: The financial technologies later than in m12b-first.
_predictions.entries: The railways and flash-freezing entries complete stages again (0 in m12b-first; the canon 12.6 and 26.7 a run).
_predictions.military: Still behind its anchors (no ruled change reaches the doctrine and naval technologies); automatic machine guns still late.
_predictions.world_gdp: Direction NOT argued: earlier engines push it up, later financial technologies down. m12b-first ended at 0.82x vanilla 1.15.2 (0.71-1.02).
_predictions.administration_urban: Identification documents' first holder near 1875 (1848 in m12b-first, vanilla 1875); elevator after 1890 (1880; vanilla 1893); paved roads after 1915 (1897; vanilla 1917); mass surveillance and macroeconomics in the 1920s or later. The urban figures are estimates (the summaries do not record the largest urban centre), so their timing is the least certain.

_stop_rule: None: a fixed-n batch, every run plays to 1936 (fixed-n batches run to completion), as the m12b-first batches.
_cost: 3 x 1836 -> 1936, about 2 h 45 min - 3 h each, about 9 hours from the launch on 2026-11-22 ~14:40 local, ending around 23:30 local.
